Title: EVT-OP-020: Anticlustering for block lengths between log n and n^ε
Labels: open-problem, area:dependence, type:research, difficulty:hard, status:research

**Status in the survey:** Left open, by the repository's reading (`docs/NOVELTY2.md`) of Bai–Kulik–Wang Cor. 1.6. No verbatim quote: their model has anticlustering for `d_n = o(log n)` and it fails for `d_n ≫ n^ε`.

## Source and quote
## Why it matters
It is the remaining gap in the anticlustering range of their model.

## What the library already has
Echo-process analogues only, such as `powEchoProcess_antiClustering_iff`.

## What is missing
The stable-regenerative model.
